title: Simple invoicing + VAT/URSSAF app for French auto-entrepreneurs

source.text: A simple invoicing app for French freelancers (auto-entrepreneurs) that handles VAT and URSSAF declarations, 9 EUR a month. Launch country FR, budget 1,000 EUR, 10 hours a week, goal side income, edge: I am a developer. Just go: do not ask questions.

problem: Auto-entrepreneurs must invoice and handle VAT and URSSAF declarations
solution: A simple invoicing app that handles VAT and URSSAF declarations
assumptions: Price read as EUR 9/month excl. VAT
Target = service micro-entrepreneurs (BNC), the largest segment
